description: Quantify the would-be RNA interface of the superposed LEE1 fingers against the real TIS11d interface and plot the stacking-position comparison
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}

# ---- reload 1RGO model1 and AlphaFold LEE1 ----
pdb=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1RGO.pdb",headers=H,timeout=120).text
rows=[];st=False
for ln in pdb.split("\n"):
    if ln.startswith("MODEL"):
        if st: break
        st=True; continue
    if ln.startswith("ENDMDL"): break
    if st and ln.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
        nm=ln[12:16].strip(); el=(ln[76:78].strip() or nm[0])
        if el=="H" or nm.startswith("H"): continue
        rows.append((int(ln[22:26]),ln[17:20].strip(),nm,float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["num","res","atom","x","y","z"])
RNAxyz=T[T.res.isin({"A","U","G","C"})][["x","y","z"]].values
Tprot=T[(~T.res.isin({"A","U","G","C"}))&(T.res!="ZN")]

af=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q02799",headers=H,timeout=90).json()
aftxt=requests.get(af[0]["pdbUrl"],timeout=120).text
rows=[]
for ln in aftxt.split("\n"):
    if ln.startswith("ATOM"):
        nm=ln[12:16].strip()
        if (ln[76:78].strip() or nm[0])=="H": continue
        rows.append((int(ln[22:26]),ln[17:20].strip(),nm,float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54]),float(ln[60:66])))
L=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["num","res","atom","x","y","z","plddt"])

def anchors(c1,sp):
    a,b,c=sp
    lab=['C1']+[f'C1+{k}' for k in range(1,a+1)]+['C2']+[f'C2+{k}' for k in range(1,b+1)]+['C3']+[f'C3+{k}' for k in range(1,c+1)]+['H']
    return dict(zip(lab,range(c1,c1+len(lab))))
Tz={'ZF1':anchors(159,(8,5,3)),'ZF2':anchors(197,(8,5,3))}
Lz={'ZF1':anchors(93,(7,5,3)), 'ZF2':anchors(124,(7,5,3))}
COMMON=['C1','C1+1','C1+2','C2','C2+1','C2+2','C2+3','C2+4','C2+5','C3','C3+1','C3+2','C3+3','H']
def ca(df,n):
    r=df[(df.num==n)&(df.atom=="CA")]; return r[["x","y","z"]].values[0]
def kabsch(P,Q):
    Pc,Qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); M=(P-Pc).T@(Q-Qc); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(M)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T)); R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T; return R,Qc-R@Pc

res_rows=[]
for zf in ['ZF1','ZF2']:
    P=np.array([ca(L,Lz[zf][p]) for p in COMMON]); Q=np.array([ca(T,Tz[zf][p]) for p in COMMON])
    R,t=kabsch(P,Q); rmsd=np.sqrt((((R@P.T).T+t-Q)**2).sum(1).mean())
    sel=L[(L.num>=Lz[zf]['C1'])&(L.num<=Lz[zf]['H'])].copy()
    sel[["x","y","z"]]=(R@sel[["x","y","z"]].values.T).T+t
    tsel=Tprot[(Tprot.num>=Tz[zf]['C1'])&(Tprot.num<=Tz[zf]['H'])]
    for lab,df in [("TIS11d",tsel),("LEE1(superposed)",sel)]:
        d=np.sqrt(((df[["x","y","z"]].values[:,None,:]-RNAxyz[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1)).min(1)
        g=df.assign(minRNA=d)
        per=g.groupby(["num","res"]).minRNA.min().reset_index()
        res_rows.append(dict(finger=zf,model=lab,rmsd=round(rmsd,2),
                             atoms_within_4A=int((d<4.0).sum()),atoms_within_5A=int((d<5.0).sum()),
                             residues_within_4A=int((per.minRNA<4.0).sum()),
                             clashes_lt_2_2A=int((d<2.2).sum()),
                             aromatic_atoms_within_4A=int(((d<4.0)&g.res.isin(["PHE","TYR","TRP"])).sum()),
                             basicN_within_4A=int(((d<4.0)&g.res.isin(["LYS","ARG"])&g.atom.isin(["NZ","NH1","NH2","NE"])).sum()))
                        )
IF=pd.DataFrame(res_rows)
print("=== Would-be RNA interface of the superposed LEE1 fingers vs the real TIS11d interface ===")
print(IF.to_string(index=False))
IF.to_csv('lee1_superposed_interface_vs_tis11d.csv',index=False)

# ---------------- figure ----------------
dat=pd.DataFrame({
 'position':['ZF1 C2+2\n(stack #1)','ZF1 C3+2\n(stack #2)','ZF2 C2+2\n(stack #1)','ZF2 C3+2\n(stack #2)'],
 'TIS11d':['Tyr170','Phe176','Tyr208','Phe214'],
 'LEE1':['Ala103','Phe109','Phe134','Asn140'],
 'TIS11d_d':[3.65,3.39,3.75,3.41],
 'LEE1_d':[4.38,3.41,3.76,3.24],
 'aromatic_kept':[False,True,True,False]})
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,4.8))
x=np.arange(4); w=0.38
ax[0].bar(x-w/2,dat.TIS11d_d,w,label='TIS11d side chain (bound RNA, 1RGO)',color='#1864ab')
ax[0].bar(x+w/2,dat.LEE1_d,w,label='LEE1 side chain after superposition',
          color=['#2b8a3e' if a else '#c92a2a' for a in dat.aromatic_kept])
for i,(a,b,ta,la) in enumerate(zip(dat.TIS11d_d,dat.LEE1_d,dat.TIS11d,dat.LEE1)):
    ax[0].text(i-w/2,a+0.08,ta,ha='center',fontsize=8); ax[0].text(i+w/2,b+0.08,la,ha='center',fontsize=8,
        color='#2b8a3e' if dat.aromatic_kept[i] else '#c92a2a')
ax[0].set_xticks(x); ax[0].set_xticklabels(dat.position,fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_ylabel("closest distance to RNA (A)"); ax[0].set_ylim(0,5.4)
ax[0].set_title("The two base-stacking positions of each TIS11d finger.\nLEE1 fills one per finger with an aromatic, the other with Ala or Asn",fontsize=10)
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False,loc='lower right')

sub=IF.pivot(index='finger',columns='model',values='residues_within_4A')
sub2=IF.pivot(index='finger',columns='model',values='aromatic_atoms_within_4A')
xx=np.arange(2)
ax[1].bar(xx-w/2,sub['TIS11d'],w,color='#1864ab',label='TIS11d residues <4 A of RNA')
ax[1].bar(xx+w/2,sub['LEE1(superposed)'],w,color='#868e96',label='LEE1 residues <4 A of the same RNA')
ax[1].plot(xx-w/2,sub2['TIS11d'],'o-',color='#f59f00',label='TIS11d aromatic atoms <4 A')
ax[1].plot(xx+w/2,sub2['LEE1(superposed)'],'o--',color='#f59f00',mfc='white',label='LEE1 aromatic atoms <4 A')
ax[1].set_xticks(xx); ax[1].set_xticklabels(sub.index)
ax[1].set_ylabel("count"); ax[1].set_title("Size of the would-be RNA interface\n(CA RMSD of the superposition: ZF1 0.64 A, ZF2 0.49 A)",fontsize=10)
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
